sourcing_policy: All 13 documents are freshly sourced for this Golden Set build via Wikipedia's official PDF export API (https://{lang}.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/pdf/{title}), CC BY-SA licensed. Deliberately independent of any document previously used in this project — not eval/documents (old, deleted, tied to a retired FAISS/sentence-transformers architecture) and not real_test_documents/ (used earlier in this session for parser/outline testing; 2 of its files were already uploaded and manually tested against the live app, which would have biased selection). This objectivity constraint was explicit: 'tôi muốn bộ eval thật khách quan không liên quan gì đến data hiện tại'.
